annotations.text: Three defects found by reading the code, not by taste: caution and gold are the same hex; 365 arbitrary font sizes, most of them 10–11px; eight card surfaces with no elevation ladder. Foundations fixes the tokens; the three phone screens show the tokens doing work.
Drawing this found a live bug: the generated artwork never rendered. Fixed in src/lib/food/artwork.ts — the note at the bottom of the artboard has the detail.
